2608.00891.title: CADIR: A Cross-Backend Editable Intermediate Representation for Agentic CAD Generation
2608.00891.paper_summary: Large language models have made it possible to generate executable computer-aided design (CAD) programs from natural-language descriptions or images. However, existing methods represent modeling processes as backend-specific sequential scripts with implicit dependencies or as static geometry, making it difficult to simultaneously preserve construction history, stable topological references, and feature-level editability across different CAD systems. We present CADIR, an agent-friendly executable intermediate representation for CAD generation and cross-backend editing. Built on the OCCT geometry kernel via OCP, CADIR provides explicit, compositional modeling operations and fine-grained execution diagnostics. During program execution, CADIR records modeling operations, parameter dependencies, constraints, and topology selections in a construction graph. To enable reliable cross-backend reconstruction, we introduce Geometric Signature Matching, which identifies corresponding edges and faces despite parameter changes and backend differences, allowing adapters to reconstruct native editable feature histories in FreeCAD, SolidWorks, and Fusion 360. Building on this representation, we further propose a construction-graph retrieval method for text and image queries that supports both full-graph and subgraph retrieval, enabling agents to leverage complete models and modeling substructures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CADIR achieves higher geometric fidelity and execution reliability than existing CAD representations, that construction-graph retrieval further improves model generation quality, and that cross-backend editing enables reliable model reconstruction and post-reconstruction editing across multiple CAD environments.
2608.00891.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型使得從自然語言描述或圖像生成可執行的計算機輔助設計（CAD）程序成為可能。<lb/>然而，現有的方法將建模過程表示為特定後端的順序腳本，具有隱式依賴關係，或作為靜態幾何，這使得在不同的CAD系統中同時保留建設歷史、穩定的拓撲參考和特徵級可編輯性變得困難。<lb/>我們提出了CADIR，一種友好的可執行中介表示，用於CAD生成和跨後端編輯。<lb/>CADIR基於OCCT幾何內核通過OCP構建，提供明確的組合建模操作和細粒度的執行診斷。<lb/>在程序執行過程中，CADIR在建設圖中記錄建模操作、參數依賴、約束和拓撲選擇。<lb/>為了實現可靠的跨後端重建，我們引入了幾何簽名匹配，該方法能夠識別對應的邊和面，儘管參數變化和後端差異，從而允許適配器在FreeCAD、SolidWorks和Fusion 360中重建本地可編輯的特徵歷史。<lb/>基於這一表示，我們進一步提出了一種支持文本和圖像查詢的建設圖檢索方法，該方法支持全圖和子圖檢索，使代理能夠利用完整模型和建模子結構。<lb/>大量實驗表明，CADIR在幾何保真度和執行可靠性方面優於現有的CAD表示，建設圖檢索進一步改善了模型生成質量，並且跨後端編輯使得在多個CAD環境中實現可靠的模型重建和重建後編輯成為可能。
